newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel buoyed by support at 129.92.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel buoyed by support at 129.92.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF appeared well supported on Monday, technical analysts said, though scope for major upward gains was limited.
"We have seen a bounce from support at 129.92," said Martin Scott, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London. "We have also come up from last week's low of 129.02."
Daily charts show notionnel futures reached a high of 129.92 on July 3 and opened at that level on July 4. The contract reached the 129.02 low on July 1.
The September contract was trading at 130.04 at 0805 GMT, up 0.08.
The 129.92 level is trendline support, Scott said.
"Whilst we are above that, we will see some strength." But the session high so far on Monday of 130.14 was disappointing, he added."We are just below last week's high."
The contract reached a high on daily charts of 130.16 on July 4.
Further support lies at 129.30, while on the upside, 130.22 and 130.50 provide barriers, Scott said.
Brenda Sullivan and Elizabeth Miller of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell found resistance at the 130.18 wave extension.
"If 130.18 is breached, further gains may be seen toward 130.58 wave extension and minor wave resistance at 130.86," they said in a research note.
Short-term support is at 129.88, and more major support at 129.60, Sullivan and Miller said.
"A break of 129.52 targets retracement to the 129.24 area, and suggests a deterioration in the daily structure."
September Pibor futures were up 0.01 at 96.58 at 0825 GMT.
The contract continues in a short-term range with resistance at 96.61, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
